description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], and Phoenix Stance to the user, grants [Critical Damage +50% 3] to all allies

description.name: Roar of the Dragon
description.text: Six single attacks (0.90 each), has 25/50/75/100% additional critical chance, scaling with activations

description.name: Will of the Phoenix
description.text: Grants [Monk +30% Boost 1], [Dualcast Monk 1] to the user if user does not have Phoenix Stance, grants [Monk +30% Boost 1], [Dualcast Monk 1] to all allies if the user has Phoenix Stance, removes Phoenix Stance from the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 3
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
